_about: W4.3 role x route authorization matrix. Generated by `PYTHONPATH=. python -m tests.security.route_matrix --write`; checked by tests/security/test_route_role_matrix.py. Each row is 'METHOD path' -> gate + outcome per built-in role (DEV_MODE off). Generated with every feature flag on: a row with 'flag' exists only while that RouterMeta.enabled predicate is true. Paths exclude VIGIL_CONTEXT_PATH; frontend static routes are excluded. Review every changed row: a new 'allow' is a privilege grant.

MOUNT /mcp.note: The mounted app decides: the MCP surface toggle plus the caller's bearer token (services/api/mcp_surface.py), not a role check here.
